title: Parsing planner commands
hints: `LocalDate.parse("2026-03-14")` and `LocalTime.parse("09:00")` read the standard forms strictly: for `2026-02-30`, `9:00` or `24:00` they throw a `DateTimeParseException` (in `java.time.format`). If you write your own pattern instead, `DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("uuuu-MM-dd").withResolverStyle(ResolverStyle.STRICT)` is needed to reject February 30, which a pattern otherwise quietly adjusts.
Let small helpers throw `IllegalArgumentException` with the user-facing message, and turn every exception into an `Invalid` in one place at the end of `parse`.
